review: ISSUES:
- (miscited) "Chinese blind-ditch and pipe drainage raised rice $8.0\%$ and $6.0\%$ \parencite{Qi2025b,Asgari2021,Yang2022}" — the source attributes the rice 8.0%/6.0% figure only to Qi2025b; Asgari2021 and Yang2022 are attached in the source to a different claim ("canola in Iran improved roughly 60\% over surface drainage"), so they are borrowed keys.
- (miscited) "controlled drainage cut applied irrigation $14$--$16\%$ \parencite{Mahmoud2021,ELATFY1991}" — the 14–16% figure is Mahmoud2021 (15.6% and 14%); the source attaches ELATFY1991 to a different figure ("modified layouts reduced applied water 30--40\%"), so ELATFY1991 does not support the 14–16% claim.
- (miscited) "combined with foliar pyraclostrobin produced synergistic soybean gains up to $1070$~kg~ha$^{-1}$ \parencite{Nelson2011b,Dukhovny2018}" — the source supports the 1070 kg/ha pyraclostrobin claim only with Nelson2011b; Dukhovny2018 is used in the source for a separate claim ("Uzbek controlled drainage reduced water stress between irrigations and increased grain yields").
- (miscited) "wide-spacing reclamation lowered topsoil salinity from $8.4$ to about $2.1$~dS~m$^{-1}$ and raised cropping intensity from $143\%$ to $191\%$ \parencite{Manjunatha2004,Karegoudar2022}" — this specific claim is Manjunatha2004 in the source; Karegoudar2022 is used there for a different finding (Tungabhadra ECe reduced from ~9 to 1.9–3.8 dS/m).
- (miscited) "after four years the $0$--$1.0$~m layer fell from $27.6$ to $4.1$--$7.2$~dS~m$^{-1}$ \parencite{Zhang2021,Wang2020}" — the source attributes this figure to Zhang2021 only; Wang2020 is used for a different claim ("pipe drainage cut 0--80~cm salinity from 35 to 15~g~kg$^{-1}$").
- (miscited) "five-year data gave relative wheat yields of $95.8$, $90.3$, $83.7$, and $77.8\%$ ... \parencite{Sharma1998,AGNIHOTRI1992}" — the source attaches these yield data to Sharma1998; AGNIHOTRI1992 is used for a different claim ("conjunctive-use economics favour blending").
- (miscited) "In China, saline ($6$~g~L$^{-1}$) irrigation matched freshwater wheat yields with continued salinity decline \parencite{Gao2023,Li2023}" — this claim is Gao2023 in the source; Li2023 is used for a different claim ("brackish leaching discharged more salt than imported in favourable treatments").
- (miscited) "drainage kept saline irrigation viable up to $6.25$~dS~m$^{-1}$ for maize \parencite{Feng2017,Feng2021}" — the 6.25 dS/m maize figure is Feng2017 in the source; Feng2021 is attached to a different figure ("4.0--4.4~dS~m$^{-1}$ for grain").
- (miscited) "in Pakistan a project raised cropping intensity from $102\%$ to $157\%$ and living standards $30\%$ \parencite{Ghumman2011,Valipour2014}" — this Pakistan claim is Ghumman2011 in the source; Valipour2014 is used there for a different claim ("Indian waterlogging fell over 70\% despite less than 10\% drained area").
- (miscited) "though not all appraisals are high \parencite{Ghumman2011,ROBINSON1992,Bozic2014}" — only Ghumman2011 supports a low appraisal (Pakistan FDP recovering 1.7%/yr); the source uses ROBINSON1992 for a favourable Texas appraisal (PV \$83.1--90.9M, +\$43.4M income, 46 jobs) and Bozic2014 for phased-investment guidance, so neither supports "not all appraisals are high."
- (miscited) "globally $12$--$17\%$ of cultivated area is drained \parencite{Valipour2014,TeKrony2004}" — the 12–17% global figure is Valipour2014 in the source; TeKrony2004 is used there for a different claim ("U.S. Reclamation built over 20{,}930~km of drains protecting about 400{,}000~ha").

(6) relative wheat yields 95.8, 90.3, 83.7, 77.8% → only \parencite{Sharma1998}. (7) saline 6 g/L irrigation matched freshwater wheat yields → only \parencite{Gao2023}. (8) saline irrigation viable to 6.25 dS/m for maize → only \parencite{Feng2017}. (9) Pakistan cropping intensity 102%→157%, living standards 30% → only \parencite{Ghumman2011}. (10) "not all appraisals are high" → cite only \parencite{Ghumman2011} (Pakistan FDP recovering 1.7%/yr); remove ROBINSON1992 and Bozic2014 from that claim. (11) globally 12–17% cultivated area drained → only \parencite{Valipour2014}. Do not alter any other content.
